text:
A white plastic worktop/platform photographed from above, resting on a dark grey tiled floor visible along the right edge and bottom. The plate has a long rectangular recessed slot at the left side and many small drilled holes and shallow circular recesses across its surface.

Four square white holder blocks, each with screws at the corners, are mounted on the plate: one upper-left with a round white cap or disc seated in its central opening; one upper-right with an empty round central bore; one lower-centre with an empty round recess; and one lower-left holding a dark teal/black screw-cap fitting with a pale blue-green centre and a small white loop or tab projecting to its lower left. Two more white caps appear at the top edge.
